answer: In PoA, identity verification binds each claim to a Wesolowski VDF: producing its proof requires a prescribed chain of continuous, sequential modular squarings, so an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize one chain across GPUs to reduce its delay. Clones may run independently, but each incurs the same physical time cost, limiting Sybil throughput; relic, pigment, and crystal metadata cannot bypass this bottleneck.
